question: g4_orders_list
answer:
Done. I created [src/util/ordersApi.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g4_orders_list/source/codex/1/src/util/ordersApi.mjs) — a no-import ES module exporting `normalizeOrderList(response)` that returns `{orders, pages, total, onThisPage}`, defaulting to `[]` / `0` for anything missing.

Field mapping (from the response shape the backend defines):
- `orders` ← `response.orders` (list of orders)
- `pages` ← `response.pageCount`
- `total` ← `response.totalRecords`
- `onThisPage` ← `response.itemsOnPage`

Verified with `node --check` and a runtime smoke test (full, empty, null, and malformed inputs all produce the expected shape). Only that file changed.

Files I used to determine the shape:
- [src/pages/other/RecentOrder.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g4_orders_list/source/codex/1/src/pages/other/RecentOrder.js) — confirms the endpoint (`auth/orders/`) and that `orderData.orders` is the list.
- [src/util/constant.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g4_orders_list/source/codex/1/src/util/constant.js) and [src/util/webService.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g4_orders_list/source/codex/1/src/util/webService.js) — the exact route and that the raw `response.data` is passed through.
- Backend (read-only): `OrderApi.java` (`/auth/orders` returns `ReadableOrderList`) and the DTO `ReadableOrderList` (v0) + its base `ReadableList`, which define the `orders`, `pageCount`, `itemsOnPage`, `totalRecords` fields.
